# Wasteland toxins and antidote samples
These are poisons, not treatments. They are listed here because advanced preparations require toxin samples or black goo. Keep them apart from medicines.
## Ghostcap extract
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 2u fungus extract + 1u datura extract
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 3u ghostcap extract.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Causes poison damage; Applies seeing rainbows; At 5u or more: Applies drowsiness; At 10u or more: Reduces movement speed; At 15u or more: Applies knockdown. ## Widow's mercy
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 2u Black Goo + 2u cazador venom + 1u nightstalker venom + 2u datura extract + 2u white horsenettle extract
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 2u widow's mercy.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Causes poison, airloss damage; At 8u or more: Reduces movement speed; At 12u or more: Applies drowsiness; At 18u or more: Applies knockdown. ## Red bell poison
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u Black Goo + 2u fire toxin + 1u cazador venom + 2u datura extract + 2u glowpepper juice
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 2u red bell poison.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Causes poison, asphyxiation damage; Causes jittering; At 10u or more: Reduces movement speed; At 15u or more: Applies knockdown. ## Ash viper venom
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 2u nightstalker venom + 2u fire toxin + 1u cazador venom
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 2u ash viper venom.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Causes poison, airloss damage; Reduces movement speed; At 10u or more: Applies knockdown. ## Black goo
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u healing powder + 1u stimpak
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 1u Black Goo.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Causes poison damage. ## Black goo
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u healing powder + 1u super stimpak
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 1u Black Goo.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Causes poison damage. ## Black goo
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u healing poultice + 1u super stimpak
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 2u Black Goo.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Causes poison damage. ## Black goo
[bold]Mix:[/bold] 1u healing poultice + 1u stimpak
[bold]Makes:[/bold] 1u Black Goo.
[bold]Effects:[/bold] Causes poison damage.
